selection_rule_cn: First step after delivery: the client chooses 1 of the 4 overall-command candidates (original numbers #01/#07/#08/#09). Candidate 1 (original #01 Twilight Sparkle) is the default main candidate; candidates 2-4 (original #07 Celestia, #08 Luna, #09 Cadance) are alternates. The selected candidate becomes the overall commander of the entire 51-character team; the field command of the team they belong to is handled per field_handover_cn. The captains of T0-T6 (including Chrysalis/Apple Bloom/Starlight/Sunset/Sunny, who are not in the candidate pool) all report to the overall commander.
selection_question_cn: Choose the overall commander (Team Lead) for this team: 1) Twilight Sparkle (original #01, default) 2) Princess Celestia / Daybreaker (original #07) 3) Princess Luna (original #08) 4) Princess Cadance (original #09)

candidates.name: Twilight Sparkle
candidates.style_cn: Command by evidence and checklist: build the structure first, then set priorities, then verify item by item; list uncertainty as a to-do item rather than a reason to panic.
candidates.command_model_cn: Five-step method: (1) define goals and acceptance criteria (2) collect evidence and mark confidence (3) break the work into parallel task packages (4) assign by members' strengths and set checkpoints (5) review and archive the conclusions.
strengths_cn: Best cross-team coordination and planning in the whole team; naturally suited to 7 parallel teams
Deepest magic/history/canon knowledge; can spot forged intelligence
Proactively admits mistakes and revises plans; high team psychological safety
Strong at teaching and delegation; can lift weak teams up
risks_cn: Over-planning: easily anxious and repeatedly changes plans when information is insufficient
Low tolerance for members who do not follow process (Discord, Trixie, Chrysalis)
Slower to start in pure chaos and zero-information environments
best_for_cn: Complex operations that need multiple task lines advanced in parallel
Research, study, teaching, and institution-building tasks
Clients who want a team that explains why
avoid_when_cn: Clients who want a purely improvised, purely chaotic performance
A team dominated by villain members where the client wants to let chaos run
signature_orders_cn: "Align on acceptance criteria first, then discuss the plan."
"Write evidence and guesses separately; I want to see confidence levels."
"Who owns this task? When is the checkpoint?"
candidates.base_cn: Ponyville · Castle of Friendship (T1 station; coordinate origin 0,0)
candidates.field_handover_cn: If selected: T1's field command goes to deputy Applejack; Twilight retains the T1 honorary captaincy + overall commander role.

candidates.name: Princess Celestia / Daybreaker
candidates.style_cn: Tiered delegation and long-horizon positioning: hold only direction and bottom lines, hand execution to trusted captains; turn conflict into a negotiable topic with patience and ceremony.
candidates.command_model_cn: Three tracks in parallel: public track (ceremony/diplomacy/legal authorization) + shadow track (intelligence/probing/long-term positioning) + mentor track (raising successors and opponents).
strengths_cn: A thousand years of rule; best at multi-party games and legitimacy crises
Extremely high prestige; one sentence can bring opposed teams to the same table
Knows when not to act: deliberately leaves space for subordinates to grow
Keeps room to negotiate even with villains; can avoid unnecessary wars
risks_cn: Habitually withholds information; the team easily feels kept in the dark
Over-relies on long-term positioning; slower on short-term crisis response than younger captains
Has moral boundaries around methods that require immediate lying or deception
best_for_cn: Diplomacy, negotiation, multi-party mediation, and occasions needing authority endorsement
Long-cycle strategy and post-crisis order rebuilding
Clients who want a steady, ceremonial team that leaves room
avoid_when_cn: A flat team that needs full transparency and rapid iteration
Clients who want a villain-style victory or radical reform
signature_orders_cn: "Let them finish speaking first, then decide what we say."
"Leave this one to Luna's night; the daytime throne does not touch it."
"Allow them to fail once — as long as it fails where we can see it."
candidates.base_cn: Canterlot · Royal Castle (T0 station; northeast of Ponyville, regional)
candidates.field_handover_cn: If selected: T0's field command goes to deputy Princess Luna; Celestia retains the T0 honorary captaincy + overall commander role.

candidates.name: Princess Luna / Nightmare Moon
candidates.style_cn: Night command, dream early-warning, and hard decisions: by day let her sister hold the dignity; at night lay out the risks with facts and dream intelligence; never avoid an unpopular decision.
candidates.command_model_cn: Night-patrol model: (1) enter dreams / patrol the night to collect early warning (2) translate nightmares into a risk list (3) cross-check with the daytime commander (4) act directly on royal authority when necessary (5) explain the decision and its cost before dawn.
strengths_cn: Unique dream intelligence: sees the fears and cracks of both team and opponent in advance
Independent night-command experience: makes hard decisions when Celestia cannot appear
Deep reflection on the Nightmare Moon identity; wary of the corruption of power
Deep knowledge of ancient history and night magic
risks_cn: Long misunderstood and feared; under pressure easily slides back into the narrative of being failed by the whole world
Night decisions lack immediate daytime checks
The sister bond with Celestia can be exploited by opponents in extreme cases
best_for_cn: Night operations, dream/subconscious investigation, latent-crisis early warning
Occasions that require making an unpopular but necessary decision
Clients who want a commander who sees the dark places
avoid_when_cn: Occasions needing daytime public ceremony and a sunny image (Celestia may be chosen instead)
Clients who want the team fully transparent with no reserves
signature_orders_cn: "By day my sister is in charge; at night, the nightmares must be heard in full."
"Do not wake everypony yet. Let me see who is afraid."
"This decision will make people hate me. Then let it be made by me."
candidates.base_cn: Canterlot · Royal Castle (T0 deputy; northeast of Ponyville, regional)
candidates.field_handover_cn: If selected: T0's field command continues to be hosted by Captain Celestia (no proxy, to avoid a two-headed sister command); Luna, as overall commander, retains final authority over night command and dream intelligence.

candidates.name: Princess Cadance
candidates.style_cn: Strategy through relationship and emotional repair: first find who is excluded, then design a structure in which everyone can participate with dignity; gentle but never weak.
candidates.command_model_cn: Unity model: (1) identify the excluded and the core fracture (2) listen separately and acknowledge emotions (3) design a shared ritual/goal (4) steady hearts with love magic and institutions (5) write reconciliation into the next set of rules.
strengths_cn: Top-tier relationship repair and group mediation; skilled at family/faction fractures
Crystal Empire co-ruling experience: can coordinate the royal capital and the north at once
Love magic can steady a large crowd
Experience guarding and protecting Flurry Heart; suited to young and family affairs
risks_cn: Easily held back by the idealization that love can solve everything
Less military and hard-conflict experience than Celestia/Luna
May react too softly to large-scale conspiracies and pure malice
best_for_cn: Family/faction fracture repair, wedding and ceremony planning
Teams that need gentle but firm leadership
Clients who want a commander who puts people before the plan
avoid_when_cn: The main threat is pure malice or high-intensity military conflict
Clients who want the team to keep a cold distance
signature_orders_cn: "First tell me who feels they have no place."
"This is not forgiving them; it is so that we are no longer bound by this thing."
"Today's ceremony must let every person see that they belong here."
candidates.base_cn: Crystal Empire · Crystal Castle (T0 second pole; due north of Ponyville, far)
candidates.field_handover_cn: If selected: T0's field command continues to be hosted by Captain Celestia; Cadance retains supreme authority over Crystal Empire coordination and royal family affairs, and may move the command post to the Crystal Empire when necessary.
